notes: Share a story with other people and edit it together: invite them by email from File > Cloud > Share (a test release of sharing)
The Library card, the sync chip and Members say who last edited a shared story and when
Scenes can be deleted from the Outline (button or right-click) with Undo
Free Write: rename a page in place (double-click or F2), right-click for Rename and Delete
Text is no longer cut off at large text sizes or in a small window
Script: one line-type menu in a small window; Write, Preview and Fountain are one switch
Cards has an Add scene button
